Example survey metadata, Variable Dictionary, and Labelled Survey Data

Source: R/data.R
glad_example.Rd

A small offline example of everything qualtdict reads and produces, so its output can be explored without Qualtrics credentials. The survey structure is a subset of the GLAD Study sign-up questionnaire: four questions of the Demographics Survey Block and the whole PHQ9 and GAD7 Survey Blocks, with six Embedded Data Fields and two Scoring Variables. Together they cover a text entry question, a drop-down list, single-answer and multi-answer multiple choice (including a choice with its own text entry column), and two rating-scale matrices, with rows from the question, embedded_data, and scoring Dictionary Row Sources. The source survey defines no Text-analysis Sidecars, so the text_analysis Dictionary Row Source does not occur.

Usage

glad_example

Format

A list with six components:

survey_metadata

A list shaped like the return value of qualtRics::metadata(), with components metadata, questions, responsecounts, blocks, flow, and embedded_data. Response counts are zero and Embedded Data default values are blank.

survey_description

A list shaped like the return value of qualtRics::fetch_description(), with components metadata, flow, blocks, questions, and scoring. Embedded Data values in the Survey Flow are blank.

response_column_map

A data frame: the column_map attribute of a qualtRics::fetch_survey() download, with one row per downloaded column. qname holds the Response Column ID.

responses

A tibble of 20 rows and 48 columns of synthetic Participant Response Data, shaped like a qualtRics::fetch_survey() download with import_id = TRUE, convert = FALSE, label = FALSE, and breakout_sets = TRUE. Columns are named by Response Column ID, and response_column_map is attached as its column_map attribute.

dictionary

The Variable Dictionary (a qualtdict object, 97 rows describing 37 Response Column IDs) that dict_generate() returns for this survey with variable_name = "question_name".

labelled_survey_data

The Labelled Survey Data that survey_fetch_labelled() returns when dictionary is applied to responses.

Source

Derived from the survey metadata of the GLAD Study sign-up questionnaire. Survey, owner, brand, and account identifiers, dates, response counts, question JavaScript, and Embedded Data values were removed or replaced with fixed fake values; the survey ID is the fake "SV_glad0example00000". The responses are fully synthetic. The script that builds the data is data-raw/glad_example.R in the package source repository.

Details

The Participant Response Data in responses are synthetic: 20 responses drawn at random from each column's valid levels, with Embedded Data Fields and Scoring Variables computed from those answers, fake identifiers, and 2026 dates. They are not answers from GLAD Study participants.

Examples

names(glad_example)
#> [1] "survey_metadata"      "survey_description"   "response_column_map" 
#> [4] "responses"            "dictionary"           "labelled_survey_data"

# The Variable Dictionary: one row per Response Column ID and level
dict <- glad_example$dictionary
dict[, c(
  "response_column_id", "row_source", "variable_name", "level", "label"
)]
#> # A tibble: 97 × 5
#>    response_column_id row_source variable_name level label                      
#>    <chr>              <chr>      <chr>         <chr> <chr>                      
#>  1 QID1125_TEXT       question   DEM.AGE.1.0   NA    NA                         
#>  2 QID1126            question   DEM.COR.1.0   1     England                    
#>  3 QID1126            question   DEM.COR.1.0   2     Scotland                   
#>  4 QID1126            question   DEM.COR.1.0   3     Wales                      
#>  5 QID1126            question   DEM.COR.1.0   4     Northern Ireland           
#>  6 QID1126            question   DEM.COR.1.0   5     Outside UK                 
#>  7 QID1127            question   DEM.SEX.1.0   0     Male                       
#>  8 QID1127            question   DEM.SEX.1.0   1     Female                     
#>  9 QID1147_1          question   DEM.EDU.1.0   1     College or university degr…
#> 10 QID1147_2          question   DEM.EDU.1.0.1 1     A levels/AS levels or equi…
#> # ℹ 87 more rows

# Validation Findings: here only suggestive name repairs
findings <- dict_validate(dict)$validation_findings
findings[, c("finding", "severity", "response_column_id", "reason")]
#> # A tibble: 23 × 4
#>    finding                severity   response_column_id reason   
#>    <chr>                  <chr>      <chr>              <chr>    
#>  1 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_2          duplicate
#>  2 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_3          duplicate
#>  3 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_4          duplicate
#>  4 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_6          duplicate
#>  5 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_5          duplicate
#>  6 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID1147_5_TEXT     duplicate

#>  9 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID127303424_3     duplicate
#> 10 repaired_variable_name suggestive QID127303424_4     duplicate
#> # ℹ 13 more rows
